title.narrative: Protection assistance for vulnerable communities and migrants at risk of human trafficking in Venezuela

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide Protection assistance to people affected by negative socioeconomic conditions and climate change in Amazoas, Apure and Sucre Regions. This IOM project provides protection services to victims of trafficking. The project provides humanitarian assistance to 4,250 people, including 1,740 women, 1,401 men, 1,109 children, and including 106 persons with disabilities.
